授業科目の概要.科目名称: 学術英語・アカデミックライティング
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、信頼できる情報リソースの強力な論拠とエビデンスによる論述実践を通したライティングスキルの向上を目的とする。教師や他の学生からのフィードバックに基づいて計画、執筆、再執筆を行うライティングプロセスを学ぶことで、将来の学術的および専門的なライティング作業に備える。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course is designed to improve students’ writing skills by having them write a research essay featuring strong arguments and evidence from reliable sources. Students will learn a writing process involving planning, writing, and rewriting based on teacher and student feedback. This will prepare students for future academic and professional writing work.
Various topics will be presented that students will be asked to research and write about. The hope is that students will improve their written communication skills and gain a basic understanding of how to write well.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Academic Writing,  Paragraphs,  Essays, Oral Presentations, Communication Skills

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
Tentative Weekly Schedule
1	Students will do self introductions as written homework.		Weekly practice of writing will be essential.	Reading and writing outside of class will help you develop your skills.
2	Students write short essay on the first class topic.
3	Next topic is presented, students discuss and will write for homework.
4	Third topic will be given, students write short essay as part of class report.
5	Students will be introduced to the next topic.
6	Homework will be to do research on class topic and write feedback.
7	Next topic is presented, students discuss and will write for homework.
8	After viewing excerpts from documentary, students write short essay as part of class report.
9	The next topic is introduced.
10	Students will begin working together on group final projects.
11	Teacher will meet with students one at a time as teams work on final reports.
12	Initial draft of final essay or report should be ready by this week.
13	Students work on group reports with their team.
14	Final groups will finish their team reports.
15	All semester reports and writing are due on this day.
【Tips for Success】
Attend each class, do your best with all work, participate actively, and hand in assignments on time.
【Academic Integrity】
Original work is expected from each student. Students must not copy, or cut-and-paste any sentences or parts of sentences from the Internet, articles, or other students’ work.
Students are expected to complete major assignments at the end of the course as their final products.
